text:
mia: Trying quickstart for a new workspace created via Okta SSO — dashboard shows a card on file but the first API call returns 402.

mia: curl response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{
  "error": "billing_required",
  "reason": "org_needs_billing_consent",
  "org_id": "org_abc123"
}
```

jordan: Can you paste the full response headers + the request you're making? Also what's the token type (service key / user token)?

mia: Using the one-click quickstart service key from the Console (copied the key from the 'service keys' modal). Request is `POST /v1/generate` with Authorization: Bearer <KEY>. No extra headers.

taylor: We've seen this with SSO orgs — payment method can be attached but org-level billing consent isn't auto-accepted for SSO-created orgs. UI shows card but a separate consent flag is required.

samir: Workaround: ask an org admin to open Settings → Billing → Accept billing consent. Alternatively if you own the org you can run `redwood-cli accept-billing --org org_abc123` (we added a temporary CLI helper).

mia: Hmm that CLI helper isn't documented in quickstart, so devs get stuck. Can we surface an explicit error message from the API instead of the current generic 402 body?

devx-bot: Issue #2340 created: "SSO-created orgs need billing consent step — opaque 402 in quickstart". Triage: high. Assigned to @samir.

jordan: Good catch. We should also patch the Node/Python quickstart to detect the `reason: org_needs_billing_consent` and print a clear action: "Visit Console → Billing to accept billing — or run redwood-cli accept-billing --org <org_id>". Small code snippet:

```
// Node quickstart helper
if (res.status === 402 && body.reason === 'org_needs_billing_consent') {
  console.log('Your org needs billing consent. Visit https://console.redwood.ai/org/' + body.org_id + '/billing or run redwood-cli accept-billing --org ' + body.org_id);
  process.exit(1);
}
```

taylor: I can add the detection and friendly message to both quickstarts + a short blurb in the onboarding FAQ.

samir: I'll send a docs + sample PR today. Also adding an internal e2e for SSO org onboarding to catch regressions.

mia: I applied the local patch to the sample app and re-ran it — the UX is way better, thanks! :relieved:

jordan: We'll also add a telemetry flag so Console shows a "pending_billing_consent" banner for new orgs (makes support easier).

taylor: Sounds good. Samir, ping me once the PR is up and I'll review.

samir: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
